translations.Marcial Acharán y Smith nació el 30 de j: Marcial Acharán y Smith was born on June 30, 1837, in Valparaíso, Chile. A businessman, he conducted much of his commercial activity in Peru, especially in Trujillo, where he built strong personal and professional ties.
translations.Falleció el 14 de septiembre de 1918 en: He died on September 14, 1918, in Lima. He is remembered for his commitment to education and opportunities for young people.
translations.Comunidad educativa de Marcial Acharán y: Marcial Acharán y Smith school community at a civic event in Trujillo
translations.La comunidad educativa en una actividad: The school community at a civic event
translations.En Trujillo formó la compañía Acharán y: In Trujillo, he founded the Acharán y Goycochea company and, on June 6, 1877, was appointed vice-consul in the city. During the War of the Pacific, he traveled to France, where he encountered social and economic ideas that shaped his understanding of development.
translations.Su interés por ampliar el acceso a la ed: His desire to expand access to education led him to stipulate in his will that part of his fortune be used to establish and sustain a technical institute in Trujillo for workers' children.
translations.También apoyó la educación de sus sobrin: He also supported the education of his nephews Agustín and Víctor Raúl Haya de la Torre. Víctor Raúl later founded APRA in 1924.
translations.Estudiantes reunidos en el patio de la i: Students gathered in the school courtyard
translations.La iniciativa educativa que impulsó dio: The educational initiative he championed led to the founding of the school that bears his name, bringing technical education to young people in Trujillo. The school's establishment and operation were recognized by Director's Resolution No. 03223, dated December 5, 1981.
translations.Hoy, la I.E. Marcial Acharán y Smith man: Today, Marcial Acharán y Smith School keeps this legacy alive by supporting young people's education and contributing to Trujillo's development.
translations.Somos una Institución educativa de nivel: We are a regular basic secondary education institution providing all-round physical, emotional, cognitive, humanistic, and technological development. We nurture students' abilities, values, and attitudes so they can creatively plan and pursue their life goals.
translations.Al 2015 seremos una I.E. en vías de acre: By 2015, we will be a school pursuing internal accreditation, able to compete and lead in scientific, technological, and humanistic education. Students will be prepared to enter the workforce or continue higher education, becoming capable citizens guided by values and democratic principles who contribute to improving their community, region, and country.
translations.Frente a la problemática de la Instituci: In response to the challenges facing the school, ethical and moral principles are essential to students' all-round development. The entire school community must lead by example and practice values such as responsibility, respect, diligence, honesty, tolerance, and solidarity.
